question: How are the names of the wheel-goddesses determined in that system?
premises: Their names correspond to differences in function.
They are also formed etymologically through meditation on gentle and fierce forms of yoginis.
inference: The names of the wheel-goddesses express both their functions and the contemplative forms through which they are known.
plain_english: There, the names of the goddesses of the wheel are determined according to differences of function and by etymological formulation of the yoginis through meditation on their gentle and fierce forms.
